title: [Bug]: [dbi] INFO: [imsi-006660000000110] Cannot find IMSI in DB (../lib/dbi/subscription.c:56)

body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

Open5GS v2.7.1-23-g02d302b [2.7.2~jammy1]

### Steps to reproduce

Not sure what are the steps to reproduce it, but at some point randomly we see that the UEs can not connect anymore, we have debuted it so far to see that this is because of the HSS, we see errors that the IMSI can not be found in the DB. Also we have tested the this can be solved if we restart the HSS service:
sudo systemctl restart open5gs-hssd

After that the UEs can connect again.

Let me know what else logs are necessary
